Piano Teacher Wanted — NW OKC Studio

Growing music studio in northwest OKC is looking for a piano teacher to
join our team. Must be comfortable teaching private lessons to students
ages 6 and up, from beginner through late intermediate. We provide the
studio space and handle scheduling and billing; you bring the lesson
plans and the patience. $30/half-hour lesson, paid biweekly.

Please send a resume and a short teaching philosophy statement.
